purpose: Compile the project. Safe and non-mutating to source. Frequent dev-loop operation.
Run the test suite. Read-only against source; may write test results to bin/. Common SWE/QA tool.
Restore NuGet packages. Writes to obj/ and possibly modifies package lock; usually benign.
Apply code formatting. Modifies source files according to .editorconfig. Reversible.
Build and execute the application. Side-effects depend on the app (DB writes, file I/O). Use cautiously.
Produce release artifacts. Writes to bin/Release or publish folder; can take time.
Entity Framework migrations and DB operations. HIGH RISK — can alter database schema. Avoid in production-pointing config.
NuGet package management (push, delete, etc.). Affects shared package state. Avoid unless intentional.
